title: WhatsApp Marketing & AI Automation Platform
shortDescription: WhatsApp Marketing Platform with AI Agents
context: A WhatsApp marketing and automation SaaS platform with campaigns, integrations, and AI agents.
problem: Building reliable message routing, catalog management, and AI agent automation.
contribution: Led the technical development of the platform, focusing heavily on backend APIs and integrations. I built the Meta/WhatsApp integrations, webhooks, templates, catalog management, campaigns, and AI agents. I set up Redis and Celery for background processing. Beyond development, I managed product requirements, team tasks, UAT, production debugging, and coordinated with clients for onboarding and support.
architecture: Python/FastAPI backend with Celery and Redis for background tasks.
keyChallenges: Processing high-volume incoming webhooks and ensuring reliable message delivery.
testingReliability: Playwright automation testing, UAT, and production debugging.

title: Gold Loan Management System
shortDescription: Role-based loan processing and management system.
context: An internal system for managing gold loan applications and approvals.
problem: Building complex, state-driven loan workflows and approval chains.
contribution: Built the backend for role-based access, loan applications, customer management, and valuation workflows. I implemented the approval logic, integrated SMS/email automation for notifications, and developed the repayment tracking and NPA (Non-Performing Asset) modules.
keyChallenges: Managing strict state transitions for loan approvals securely.

title: Real-Time Trading Data POC
shortDescription: Proof of concept for distributing real-time trading data.
context: A technical POC to test distributing real-time trading data from a broker to multiple UI clients.
problem: Broker WebSocket limits restrict how many direct connections can be made, making it difficult to push data to many users.
contribution: Developed a Go service to connect to the broker WebSocket and fetch live market data. I used goroutines to process this data and push it into Redis. A Django service then broadcasted the data to multiple JavaScript UI clients via our own WebSockets.
architecture: Broker WebSocket → Go Service → Redis → Django → Client WebSockets.
keyChallenges: Syncing data across the Go and Django stack with minimal latency.

title: Automated Forex & Crypto Trading Platform
shortDescription: Automated trading execution platform with a desktop UI.
context: A custom trading tool for executing Forex and Crypto trades based on specific technical conditions.
problem: Executing trades automatically when user-defined market conditions are met.
contribution: Built the FastAPI backend that evaluates trading conditions and triggers orders. I implemented the core execution logic, including stop-loss and automatic exit rules, and integrated the Dhan and Angel One broker APIs.
architecture: Tkinter desktop app connected to a FastAPI backend.
keyChallenges: Ensuring the stop-loss and exit logic triggers reliably during volatile market conditions.
testingReliability: Condition and boundary testing for stop-loss logic.

title: Indian Market Trading & Broker Integration Platform
shortDescription: Maintenance and broker integrations for a live trading system.
context: An existing production trading platform operating in the Indian stock market.
problem: Maintaining stability while integrating new broker APIs and updating features.
contribution: Joined the project to maintain and improve the existing Django codebase. I worked heavily on broker integrations (specifically Dhan and Angel One), updated backend APIs, built scheduled cron jobs, and regularly debugged and fixed live production issues.
architecture: Django backend integrated with multiple Indian broker APIs.
keyChallenges: Fixing bugs and deploying updates safely without disrupting live trading hours.

title: NLP Chatbot Platform
shortDescription: Website chatbot powered by NLP and semantic search.
context: A custom chatbot widget that answers user questions based on a specific knowledge base.
problem: Building a system that understands user intent and allows admins to easily update the knowledge base.
contribution: Developed the FastAPI backend and implemented the core NLP and semantic search logic to match user queries with the right answers. I also built the admin flows so site owners could update the MySQL knowledge base and retrain the search index.
architecture: FastAPI backend running NLP and semantic search against a MySQL database.
keyChallenges: Implementing semantic search efficiently without relying on heavy external APIs.
testingReliability: Admin flow testing for retraining models.

title: School Management / CRM Platform
shortDescription: Django-based school administration and attendance system.
context: An internal administration portal for schools to manage students and staff.
problem: Tracking daily attendance and managing data across different user roles.
contribution: Worked on the Django backend to manage student and employee records. I implemented the logic to process daily biometric attendance data and wrote cron jobs to generate attendance reports. I also handled general bug fixes for the live system.
keyChallenges: Accurately syncing and processing hardware biometric attendance logs into the database.

title: Job Application & Payment Platform
shortDescription: Job application portal with Razorpay payment integration.
context: A web portal where users can apply for specific jobs and pay application fees.
problem: Processing user applications and reliably tracking payment statuses.
contribution: Built the backend application forms and integrated the Razorpay API to collect fees. I implemented the webhook listeners to verify payments and automatically update the application status in the database.
architecture: Django backend with Razorpay API integration.
keyChallenges: Ensuring database records stayed perfectly synced with Razorpay webhook events.

title: Market Data ML Analysis Platform
shortDescription: Data analysis tool using XGBoost on historical stock data.
context: A financial analysis tool that applies machine learning to historical market data.
problem: Visualizing how historical trends might map to short-term future performance.
contribution: Trained an XGBoost model using historical stock datasets to generate 1-day and 7-day trend analysis. I built the backend logic to calculate potential ROI or loss based on a user's mock investment, and formatted the output for frontend charts and tables.
architecture: Python backend serving XGBoost analysis results to a frontend.
keyChallenges: Formatting the model outputs into clean datasets that the frontend charting libraries could easily render.

title: Velomiq — Enterprise Email Service Platform
shortDescription: Custom Email Service Platform for high-volume campaigns.
context: A personal project replicating an enterprise Email Service Platform for managing bulk email delivery.
problem: Sending bulk emails requires solid background processing, deliverability controls, and campaign management.
contribution: Built the complete platform from scratch. I engineered the campaign management and templating features, and integrated Celery for queuing bulk email tasks. I implemented SMTP provider routing, domain management, suppression lists, and basic DMARC controls to handle sender reputation.
architecture: FastAPI and Celery backend with a Next.js dashboard.
keyChallenges: Setting up reliable Celery worker queues to handle high-volume email dispatch.
testingReliability: Scale testing for Celery worker queues.

title: AI Job Application Platform
shortDescription: AI-assisted job discovery and application builder.
context: A personal project that parses user resumes to find relevant job postings and prepare applications.
problem: Reducing the manual work of searching for jobs and filling out applications, while keeping the user in control.
contribution: Built a data extraction pipeline to parse resumes and used the Adzuna API to discover matching job postings. I integrated the Gemini API to help correct and format the extracted data. Finally, I built a workflow that generates a prefilled application and requires the user to review and confirm it before anything is submitted.
architecture: Django backend, Celery for API tasks, Adzuna and Gemini integrations, and a React frontend.
keyChallenges: Extracting clean, structured data from unpredictable resume formats.

title: To Do List
shortDescription: To Do list app built with Angular.
